comments.content:
Josh on the design monoculture question: "Things have become homogenous for a while. I feel like we're in a place where maybe it'll break back out a little bit."

He traces this partly to AI lowering the cost of experimentation. Not in a hype way, but more like a tinkerer noticing the tools have changed.

The Mosaic icon style traces back to Josh's Uni Calendar letterpress project. It’s geometric, mid-century-ish, built on reusable shapes. A made-for-print aesthetic that got adapted for screen. Jory has all of them. Because of course he does.
